status: Hypothetical whole occupied-area planning scenario: 220 m station length x assumed 6 m aggregate waiting width x assumed usable fraction 0.8. Not a surveyed whole-station volume.
outdoor_radiant_note: Shaded longwave approximation, separately specified; not a physical identity between radiant and air temperature
air_exchange_note: Balanced outdoor exchange surrogate; the last two minutes of each cycle are an assumed arrival/opening disturbance, not a piston-flow law
occupancy_note: Mean simultaneous people rise linearly throughout each headway and reset at departure; fractional counts represent a deterministic average
person_load_note: Vapor rate estimated as 45 W / (2.45 MJ/kg); enthalpy source is g*(2501000+1860*T), not a second added 45-W latent term
device_note: Variable integer count matrix x[z,k], with mixed A/B/C allowed. All device power counted; all electrical input becomes local sensible heat. Current zone inlet drives evaporative recirculation. Local device-speed profiles and footprints are unmeasured assumptions.

venue_context.name: Canberra MRT station, Singapore
venue_context.note: Building context only. Occupied area is assumed 220m x6m aggregate waiting width x0.8 usable fraction. Effective height4m is not 17m column height. The reference local24x10x4m case supplies assumed per-area scaling parameters only.

coverage_note: Unmeasured disjoint device airflow footprints, not cold-air mass conservation cells. Uniform occupancy within each thermal zone; all subgroups share bulk T,RH,MRT. Footprints scale only service weighting, not device mass flow.
area_scaling_note: Air volume, envelope storage and conductances, effective solar load, interzone exchange and occupancy scale by 4.4 from the local 240m2 scenario. ACH is unchanged. This is assumed similarity, not measured scaling.
